title: The logger factory refuses to construct with an unknown level string
asA: operator wiring the logger factory at boot with a mis-configured minimum level
iWant: the factory to refuse construction with a message naming the unknown level and the accepted vocabulary
soThat: a typo in the environment variable is caught at boot rather than silently dropping every emission

acceptanceCriteria.description: The factory refuses to construct when the elicited minimum level is not one of the recommended-default vocabulary (trace, debug, info, warn, error, fatal); the thrown error names the offending value and lists the accepted set. Template values the applying agent sets: The applying agent sets the elicited minimum-log-level per environment; the AC substitutes the elicited threshold for the illustrative info.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an application booting with minimum level set to 'verbose'
acceptanceCriteria.then: the construction throws with a message naming 'verbose' as the offending value and listing the accepted vocabulary

acceptanceCriteria.description: The factory refuses to construct when the elicited minimum level is provided in the wrong case (e.g. "INFO", "Warn"); the thrown error names the offending value and lists the accepted lower-case vocabulary. The vocabulary is case-sensitive by design.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an application booting with minimum level set to "INFO"
acceptanceCriteria.then: construction throws with a message naming "INFO" as the offending value and listing the accepted lower-case vocabulary trace/debug/info/warn/error/fatal

description: Section 7a floor: two ACs. ADR-1604 and TAC-1601 name no US-15106-specific failure paths beyond unknown-level-value (AC-15106-1) and wrong-case (AC-15106-2); further boundary classes for construction-time level validation are not documented on this mechanism.
